rationale: Round-4 final confirm at f6847729 under the codebase-pin lens. (1) Both mandated new tests run green uncached in the bead worktree: TestStateShow_AmbientMainCheckout_BranchOnlyDraft_ShadowTagDoesNotHideIt (the end-to-end ambient repro) and TestLocalBranchNames_RealGit_SurvivesShadowTag (the primitive unit) — plus the third, TestDiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache_BranchOnlyDraft_ShadowTagDoesNotHideIt at the enumeration layer that was actually vulnerable. Notably the LocalBranchNames unit test PASSED rather than skipped, meaning its built-in control (asserting LocalBranchRefs's %(refname:short) really does disambiguate under the shadow tag on this git) held — the disambiguation claim the whole fix rests on is empirically true here, and the skip-guard makes the test honest on git versions where it would not be. (2) Red-on-revert PROBED at the exact seam the commit names: in a /tmp archive with DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache's one call swapped back to gitutil.LocalBranchRefs, both the enumeration-layer test and the ambient state-show test fail, pinning that round 2's qualified-ref probe alone did not cover this and the enumeration fix is load-bearing. (3) The argv-ratchet entry for LocalBranchNames is honest: the function's argv is entirely fixed literals (for-each-ref --format=%(refname:lstrip=2) refs/heads) plus workdir via gitArgs's -C — no ref/branch/id operand exists to gate, matching the opClassStringLiteral disposition and Count 1; the internal/lint suite (which enforces the count) passes. (4) The sibling-not-in-place design is verifiably sound: LocalBranchRefs's three other consumers (Executor interface, layout precondition, finalize_orphans) keep their reviewed behavior, and only resolve.go's draft enumeration switched. Hermeticity unchanged (t.TempDir fixtures, seams, the copied newBranchOnlyDraftFixture is byte-equivalent to the resolve-package original). Full go test -count=1 -short ./... green; bead worktree left byte-identical. Standing APPROVE confirmed for the unchanged remainder from rounds 2-3; carried-forward non-blocking notes (R2r2-F1 fixture-root nit, R2r2-F2 comment overclaim, R2r2-F3 warn-only CommitAll boundary) remain recorded for follow-up, none blocking. The disclosed out-of-scope remainder (RemoteTrackingRefs's %(refname:short), layout-only) was reported to the orchestrator rather than silently patched — the honest disposition.

findings.title: Round-4 fix verified at all three layers; enumeration revert probe red at the named seam
findings.detail: LocalBranchNames' lstrip=2 form is disambiguation-proof by construction and byte-identical to :short in the ordinary case; the unit test's control empirically confirmed the :short disambiguation on this git before asserting. Both consumer-layer tests fail with LocalBranchRefs restored in a /tmp copy, and only nothing else. The ratchet entry's fixed-literal claim matches the code exactly. Nothing new to ask; prior rounds' non-blocking notes carry forward unchanged.
